questions.prompt: Tujya tubona imvura nyinshi muri uku kwezi. Ni ko bihora iteka.
questions.answer: We (customarily) have much rain in this month. That's how it always is.

questions.prompt: Abantu bamwe bagira amaguru maremare cyane. Ayanjye ni magufi.
questions.answer: Some people have very long legs. Mine are short.

questions.prompt: Rwose, ntabwo nzi ukuntu nzashobora kurangiza imirimo yose muri uku kwezi.
questions.answer: Really, I truly don't know how I will be able to finish all the work in this month.

questions.prompt: Mwana wanjye, kwizera kwawe ni ko kuzagukiza.
questions.answer: My child, it is your faith that will save you.

questions.prompt: Abantu bajya bacogora kenshi, ariko Imana igira amaboko
questions.answer: People often get discouraged, but God is able (has arms).

questions.prompt: Kuvuga si ko kubirangiza; ahubwo gukora ni ko kuduha ibyiringiro byo kubishobora.
questions.answer: Talking about it is not getting it done; to the contrary, working gives us hope that we will be able (to get it done).

questions.prompt: Sinshaka kuvuga ibyo kungenda kwe. Ariko nzakomeza kwiringira yuko azagaruka.
questions.answer: I don't want to talk about her leaving. Nevertheless, I shall continue to hope that she will return.

questions.prompt: Kugerageza no gukora ni byo bizana amajyambere.
questions.answer: Trying and working--those are what bring progress.

questions.prompt: Ni tugera mu gihugu cyabo tuzaririmba indirimbo zo kunesha.
questions.answer: When we get to their country, we will sing songs of victory.
Pain and crying will not exist again.

questions.prompt: Nzi yuko nzamushima n'aza, kuko ahora ampa ibyiringiro
questions.answer: I know that I will thank him when he comes, because he always gives me hope.

questions.prompt: Buhoro buhoro ni rwo rugendo rwo gusohora.
questions.answer: Little by little--that is the way to arrive.

questions.prompt: Guhorana ibyishimo n'ibyiringiro ni byo bizaduha kunesha imibabaro yose.
questions.answer: To constantly have gratitude and hope--these are what will enable us to conquer all suffering.

questions.prompt: Ntidukwiriye gucogora. Amaherezo tuzaririmba dufite ibyishimo byinshi.
questions.answer: We must not get discouraged. We will finally sing with much happiness.

questions.prompt: Si kenshi imvura igwa muri uku kwezi.
questions.answer: It's not often that rain falls in this month.

questions.prompt: Ni tunesha kubwa ubushobozi bw'umuyobozi wacu, ntituzongera kubabara iteka.
questions.answer: If we triumph, thanks to the leadership of our leader, we will never suffer again.
